meaning: บ่งบอก / สื่อความหมายโดยนัย

The data implies a strong correlation between diet and health.

translations: สื่อความหมายโดยนัย

meaning: อนุมาน / ตีความ
examples: We can infer from the passage that the author supports reform.
She inferred from his tone that he was unhappy.
What can you infer about the character's motivation?

meaning: ขัดแย้ง
examples: His actions contradict his earlier statements.
The new findings contradict the original hypothesis.
Evidence from the second study directly contradicts the first.

meaning: หลักฐาน
examples: The author provides strong evidence to support the argument.
There is no evidence that the policy reduced crime.
She cited three studies as evidence for her claim.

meaning: มุมมอง
examples: Consider the issue from multiple perspectives.
The story is told from the perspective of a child.
Her perspective changed after reading the article.

meaning: ยืนยัน / กล่าวอ้างอย่างมั่นใจ
examples: The report asserts that climate change is accelerating.
She asserted her right to speak at the meeting.
He asserted that the evidence was inconclusive.
translations: กล่าวอ้างอย่างมั่นใจ

meaning: ประเมิน / วิจารณ์
examples: Evaluate the strength of the author's argument.
Teachers evaluate students based on multiple criteria.
We need to evaluate the evidence before drawing conclusions.

meaning: ความถูกต้อง / ความสมเหตุสมผล
examples: Question the validity of arguments lacking evidence.
The validity of the study was confirmed by peer review.
Without solid data, the claim has little validity.
translations: ความถูกต้อง
ความสมเหตุสมผล

meaning: ข้อสมมุติฐาน / การสันนิษฐาน
examples: The argument rests on a faulty assumption.
Do not make assumptions without checking the facts.
His assumption that everyone agreed turned out to be wrong.
translations: ข้อสมมุติฐาน
การสันนิษฐาน

meaning: ประเมิน
examples: We must assess the risks before making a decision.
The committee assessed the impact of the new policy.
Doctors assess patients before recommending treatment.

meaning: ระบุ / ตัดสิน / กำหนด
examples: Scientists are trying to determine the cause of the disease.
The judge will determine the outcome of the case.
We need to determine the best course of action.

meaning: ชัดเจน / ระบุตรงๆ
examples: The instructions were explicit and easy to follow.
The author makes an explicit argument against discrimination.
Be explicit about your expectations from the beginning.

meaning: โดยนัย / ไม่ได้พูดตรงๆ
examples: There was an implicit warning in the author's tone.
The implicit message of the story is about resilience.
His approval was implicit rather than openly stated.
translations: ไม่ได้พูดตรงๆ

meaning: เพียงพอ
examples: One example is not sufficient to prove a general point.
The evidence was sufficient to support the claim.
Is this amount of data sufficient for the analysis?

meaning: บรรทัดฐาน
examples: The court's ruling set an important legal precedent.
There is no historical precedent for such a dramatic change.
Breaking with precedent requires careful justification.

meaning: การตีความ
examples: Her interpretation of the poem differed from the teacher's.
There are multiple valid interpretations of the data.
The lawyer offered a different interpretation of the law.

meaning: สอดคล้อง / สม่ำเสมอ
examples: The results were consistent across all three studies.
Her argument is consistent with the evidence presented.
A consistent writing style makes an essay easier to follow.

meaning: จุดยืน
examples: What is the author's stance on environmental policy?
She took a firm stance against workplace discrimination.
His stance shifted after reviewing the new evidence.

meaning: แสดงภาพ / พรรณนา
examples: The article portrays the community in a negative light.
How does the author portray the main character?
The documentary portrays the struggles of migrant workers.

meaning: แสดงเหตุผลสนับสนุน
examples: Justify your answer with evidence from the text.
Can you justify this decision with data?
The government failed to justify the new restrictions.
translations: แสดงเหตุผลสนับสนุน

meaning: ยอมรับ / ยินยอม
examples: The author concedes that the evidence is not conclusive.
He conceded that his opponent made a valid point.
Even critics concede that the policy had some benefits.

meaning: กล่าวซ้ำ / อธิบายใหม่
examples: Restate the main argument in your own words.
She restated her position more clearly after the objection.
The conclusion restates the thesis with new insight.
translations: อธิบายใหม่

meaning: อ้างอิง
examples: Always cite your sources in academic writing.
The lawyer cited a previous case as precedent.
She cited three studies to support her claim.

meaning: สื่อสาร / ถ่ายทอด
examples: The poem conveys a deep sense of loss.
She used vivid language to convey her emotions.
Good writing conveys complex ideas clearly.

meaning: อคติ / ความลำเอียง
examples: The report showed a clear bias toward one side.
Journalists must strive to avoid bias in their writing.
Confirmation bias leads people to seek only supporting evidence.
translations: ความลำเอียง

meaning: ความเกี่ยวข้อง
examples: Make sure all your evidence has relevance to the topic.
The relevance of the data to the argument was questioned.
Choose examples that have direct relevance to your claim.
translations: ความเกี่ยวข้อง

meaning: แยกแยะ
examples: Can you distinguish between fact and opinion in this passage?
It is important to distinguish correlation from causation.
The author distinguishes two seemingly similar ideas.

meaning: บั่นทอน / ทำให้อ่อนแอ
examples: The new evidence undermines the original claim.
Constant criticism can undermine a person's confidence.
Corruption undermines public trust in institutions.
translations: ทำให้อ่อนแอ

meaning: เสริมความแข็งแกร่ง
examples: This example reinforces the author's central argument.
Positive feedback reinforces good behavior.
The study's findings reinforce earlier research conclusions.
translations: เสริมความแข็งแกร่ง

meaning: ขยายความ / อธิบายเพิ่มเติม
examples: Could you elaborate on that point?
The author elaborates on the causes of the economic crisis.
Please elaborate your answer with specific examples.
translations: อธิบายเพิ่มเติม

meaning: เปลี่ยนแปลง / เปลี่ยนทิศทาง
examples: The author's tone shifts in the final paragraph.
A shift in public opinion led to policy change.
There has been a significant shift in how we view education.
translations: เปลี่ยนแปลง
เปลี่ยนทิศทาง

meaning: เป็นหลัก / ส่วนใหญ่
examples: The article is aimed primarily at young voters.
She is primarily responsible for the success of the project.
The problem is primarily caused by lack of communication.

meaning: หักล้าง / โต้แย้ง
examples: The scientist refuted the hypothesis with new data.
He was unable to refute the claims made against him.
A strong counterargument refutes the opposing view directly.

meaning: พิสูจน์ / สนับสนุนด้วยหลักฐาน
examples: Can you substantiate that claim with evidence?
The report substantiates concerns about air quality.
She substantiated her argument with multiple peer-reviewed studies.
translations: สนับสนุนด้วยหลักฐาน

meaning: สรุปภาพรวม / ด่วนสรุป
examples: It is dangerous to generalize based on a single case.
The author generalizes too broadly about human behavior.
Avoid generalizing without sufficient evidence.
translations: สรุปภาพรวม

meaning: ยืนยัน / สนับสนุนด้วยหลักฐาน
examples: The witness's testimony corroborated the physical evidence.
Multiple studies corroborate these findings.
Can you find another source to corroborate this claim?
translations: สนับสนุนด้วยหลักฐาน

meaning: บ่งบอกลักษณะ / พรรณนา
examples: How does the author characterize the role of government?
The report characterizes the situation as a public health crisis.
She characterized his behavior as irresponsible.
translations: บ่งบอกลักษณะ

meaning: ความน่าเชื่อถือ
examples: Citing expert sources increases your credibility.
The source lacks credibility because of its clear bias.
A writer's credibility depends on the evidence they provide.
translations: ความน่าเชื่อถือ

meaning: ความไม่สอดคล้อง / ความแตกต่าง
examples: There is a discrepancy between the two reports.
The auditors discovered a discrepancy in the financial records.
This discrepancy in the data needs to be explained.
translations: ความไม่สอดคล้อง
ความแตกต่าง

meaning: น่าเชื่อถือ / เป็นไปได้
examples: The author offers a plausible explanation for the trend.
Is this theory plausible given the available evidence?
He gave a plausible account of what happened.
translations: น่าเชื่อถือ

meaning: สมมุติฐาน
examples: The scientist tested the hypothesis through experiments.
A hypothesis must be supported by evidence to be accepted.
Her hypothesis was that stress causes memory loss.

meaning: สนับสนุน / ผู้สนับสนุน
examples: She advocates for stronger environmental protections.
The organization advocates equal rights for all citizens.
He is a well-known advocate for criminal justice reform.
translations: ผู้สนับสนุน

meaning: ประสานความขัดแย้ง / ทำให้สอดคล้อง
examples: How can we reconcile these two contradictory findings?
The mediator helped the two parties reconcile their differences.
It is difficult to reconcile his words with his actions.
translations: ประสานความขัดแย้ง
ทำให้สอดคล้อง

meaning: แยกแยะความแตกต่าง
examples: Differentiate between the author's opinion and stated facts.
The test differentiates students by reading level.
She could not differentiate between the two very similar arguments.
translations: แยกแยะความแตกต่าง

meaning: วิเคราะห์
examples: Analyze the evidence before drawing any conclusions.
The essay analyzes the causes of the economic recession.
She carefully analyzed the author's rhetorical strategies.

meaning: สรุป
examples: The author concludes that reform is urgently needed.
What can we conclude from the data presented?
He concluded his argument with a powerful call to action.

meaning: สนับสนุน
examples: This evidence supports the author's central claim.
The data supports the conclusion that exercise improves health.
She used three examples to support her argument.

meaning: เปรียบเทียบความต่าง
examples: Contrast the two characters' views on justice.
In contrast to the first study, this one found no benefit.
The essay contrasts urban and rural experiences of poverty.
translations: เปรียบเทียบความต่าง

meaning: เปรียบเทียบ
examples: Compare the two authors' approaches to the same topic.
The study compared outcomes between two groups.
When you compare the data, the trend becomes clear.
translations: เปรียบเทียบ

meaning: บ่งชี้ / แสดงให้เห็น
examples: The graph indicates a steady rise in temperatures.
Her tone indicates that she is frustrated with the situation.
The data indicates a strong link between poverty and crime.
translations: แสดงให้เห็น

meaning: เน้นย้ำ
examples: The author emphasizes the importance of early education.
She emphasized that the deadline was non-negotiable.
Bold text is used to emphasize key terms in the passage.

meaning: กล่าวถึง / จัดการ
examples: The article addresses concerns about income inequality.
The policy was designed to address environmental degradation.
She addressed the audience's questions directly.

meaning: ชี้แจง / อธิบายให้ชัดเจน
examples: Can you clarify what you mean by that term?
The author clarifies the distinction between the two concepts.
She clarified her position after the misunderstanding.
translations: อธิบายให้ชัดเจน

meaning: เปิดเผย
examples: The investigation revealed widespread corruption.
The final paragraph reveals the author's true purpose.
A close reading reveals the hidden meaning in the text.

meaning: ตรวจสอบ / พิจารณา
examples: The essay examines the causes of the financial crisis.
We need to examine the evidence more carefully.
The committee examined each proposal in detail.

meaning: ข้ออ้าง / กล่าวอ้าง
examples: The author's main claim is that education reduces inequality.
Support every claim with relevant evidence.
She claimed the policy was unconstitutional.

meaning: แสดงให้เห็น / พิสูจน์
examples: The experiment demonstrated that the hypothesis was correct.
She demonstrated how to apply the concept in practice.
His commitment demonstrates his dedication to the cause.
translations: แสดงให้เห็น

meaning: แสดงตัวอย่าง / อธิบายด้วยภาพ
examples: Use specific examples to illustrate your argument.
The chart illustrates the dramatic rise in carbon emissions.
The story illustrates the consequences of moral compromise.
translations: แสดงตัวอย่าง
อธิบายด้วยภาพ

meaning: ข้อสมมุติฐาน / หลักการเริ่มต้น
examples: The argument is built on a faulty premise.
State your premise clearly before drawing conclusions.
If the premise is false, the entire argument collapses.
translations: ข้อสมมุติฐาน
หลักการเริ่มต้น

meaning: ยอมรับ / รับรู้
examples: A strong essay acknowledges opposing viewpoints.
She acknowledged that she had made a mistake.
The author acknowledges the limitations of the study.

meaning: มองโลกในแง่ร้าย / ไม่เชื่อในความดีของคน
examples: He had a cynical view of politics after years of corruption.
The author's cynical tone suggests distrust of institutions.
She grew cynical after repeated disappointments.
translations: มองโลกในแง่ร้าย
ไม่เชื่อในความดีของคน

meaning: เป็นกลาง / ปราศจากอคติ
examples: The report aims to present an objective analysis.
A good journalist remains objective when covering controversial topics.
Try to be objective when evaluating both sides of the argument.
translations: ปราศจากอคติ

meaning: สงสัย / ไม่เชื่อง่าย
examples: She was skeptical about the new study's conclusions.
Be skeptical of information that lacks credible sources.
Scientists are trained to be skeptical of untested claims.
translations: ไม่เชื่อง่าย

meaning: ไม่ลำเอียง / เป็นกลาง
examples: Judges must remain impartial throughout the trial.
An impartial review of the evidence led to a different conclusion.
She gave an impartial assessment of both candidates.
translations: ไม่ลำเอียง

meaning: รู้สึกสองจิตสองใจ
examples: She felt ambivalent about accepting the promotion.
The public remains ambivalent about the new policy.
His ambivalent response suggested he had not decided.
translations: รู้สึกสองจิตสองใจ

meaning: เสียดสี / ล้อเลียน
examples: The article uses a satirical tone to criticize politicians.
Satirical writing often highlights social problems through humor.
The comedian's satirical sketch mocked government incompetence.

meaning: คิดถึงอดีต / โหยหาอดีต
examples: The essay has a nostalgic tone about life before technology.
She felt nostalgic looking at old photographs.
His nostalgic writing romanticizes a simpler past.
translations: คิดถึงอดีต

meaning: เศร้าโศก / หดหู่
examples: The poem has a melancholic tone throughout.
She wrote in a melancholic style that moved readers to tears.
His melancholic mood was reflected in his writing.

meaning: โกรธแค้น (เพราะไม่ยุติธรรม)

The author's indignant tone reveals anger at social injustice.
He grew indignant when his honesty was questioned.
translations: โกรธแค้น (เพราะไม่ยุติธรรม)

meaning: มีอคติ / ลำเอียง
examples: A biased source weakens any argument that relies on it.
His biased reporting favored one political party.
The study was criticized for its biased sample selection.

meaning: ประชดประชัน
examples: Her sarcastic remark masked her true frustration.
The author uses a sarcastic tone to critique consumer culture.
His sarcastic comments did not help the conversation.
translations: ประชดประชัน

meaning: มองโลกในแง่ดี
examples: The author's optimistic conclusion inspires hope for change.
She remained optimistic despite the challenges.
An optimistic tone suggests belief in a positive future.
translations: มองโลกในแง่ดี

meaning: มองโลกในแง่ร้าย
examples: The report takes a pessimistic view of economic recovery.
He was pessimistic about the chances of success.
A pessimistic tone can suggest futility or despair.
translations: มองโลกในแง่ร้าย

meaning: เป็นทางการ
examples: Academic essays require a formal writing style.
The letter was written in a very formal tone.
Formal language avoids slang and casual expressions.
translations: เป็นทางการ

meaning: ไม่เป็นทางการ
examples: The blog uses an informal, conversational tone.
Informal language makes the article feel more approachable.
She chose an informal style to connect with young readers.
translations: ไม่เป็นทางการ

meaning: ไม่แยแส / เฉยเมย
examples: The apathetic tone suggests the narrator has given up hope.
Young voters are often described as apathetic.
His apathetic response disappointed his supporters.

meaning: เห็นอกเห็นใจ
examples: The author takes a sympathetic view of the refugees.
She wrote about the victims in a sympathetic tone.
A sympathetic narrator helps readers connect with characters.
translations: เห็นอกเห็นใจ

meaning: เคร่งขรึม / จริงจัง
examples: The speaker delivered a solemn message about climate change.
The solemn tone of the passage reflects the gravity of the topic.
He made a solemn promise to protect the community.

meaning: มุ่งสอน / ให้คติสอนใจ
examples: The novel has a didactic purpose to teach moral lessons.
A didactic tone can feel preachy if overused.
The essay is didactic in its approach to civic responsibility.
translations: ให้คติสอนใจ

meaning: จริงจัง / ตั้งใจจริง
examples: Her earnest plea for change moved the audience.
He spoke with earnest conviction about justice.
The letter was earnest in its request for reform.
translations: ตั้งใจจริง

meaning: เคารพนับถือ / ยำเกรง
examples: The author writes about nature in a reverent tone.
She spoke about her mentor in a reverent way.
His reverent attitude toward tradition shapes his argument.
translations: เคารพนับถือ

meaning: ไม่เคารพ / ดูหมิ่น
examples: The article's irreverent tone challenges traditional authority.
His irreverent humor offended some readers.
She wrote an irreverent satire of political institutions.

meaning: วางท่าอวดดี / ดูถูก
examples: His condescending tone suggested he thought little of his audience.
The article was criticized for its condescending attitude toward readers.
Avoid a condescending tone when explaining complex ideas.
translations: วางท่าอวดดี

meaning: ก้าวร้าว / ชอบทะเลาะ
examples: The politician's belligerent speech alienated many voters.
A belligerent tone in negotiation rarely leads to agreement.
He became belligerent when his position was challenged.

meaning: ยั่วยุ / กระตุ้นให้เกิดปฏิกิริยา
examples: The author uses provocative questions to challenge readers.
Her provocative article sparked a national debate.
The speech was deliberately provocative to stir public anger.
translations: กระตุ้นให้เกิดปฏิกิริยา

meaning: มีความเมตตา / สงสาร
examples: The author's compassionate tone reflects deep concern for the poor.
A compassionate response to suffering includes action.
She wrote a compassionate account of the refugees' journey.
translations: มีความเมตตา

meaning: ยกย่อง / สรรเสริญ
examples: The review was laudatory, praising every aspect of the book.
The senator gave a laudatory speech honoring the volunteers.
A laudatory tone can sometimes obscure honest criticism.

meaning: เป็นการคาดเดา / ไม่มีหลักฐานแน่ชัด
examples: The article is speculative, offering little concrete evidence.
His speculative claims were not supported by data.
The author takes a speculative approach to the future of AI.
translations: เป็นการคาดเดา
ไม่มีหลักฐานแน่ชัด

meaning: เป็นไปในทางปฏิบัติ / จริงจัง
examples: She took a pragmatic approach to solving the budget crisis.

His pragmatic tone suggests a preference for practical solutions.
translations: เป็นไปในทางปฏิบัติ

meaning: ไม่ผูกพัน / เป็นกลาง
examples: The narrator's detached tone creates an objective perspective.
She described the tragedy in a cold, detached manner.
A detached writing style can feel clinical or impersonal.

meaning: ขอโทษ / รู้สึกเสียใจ
examples: The company issued an apologetic statement after the incident.
His apologetic tone acknowledged the harm caused.
She was apologetic but firm in her decision.
translations: รู้สึกเสียใจ

meaning: เป็นปฏิปักษ์ / ไม่เป็นมิตร
examples: The hostile tone of the article undermines its credibility.

A hostile work environment reduces productivity.
translations: เป็นปฏิปักษ์
ไม่เป็นมิตร

meaning: เชิงปรัชญา / ยอมรับสิ่งที่เกิดขึ้น
examples: He took a philosophical approach to the question of justice.
The essay has a philosophical tone, exploring deeper meaning.
She was philosophical about the setbacks she encountered.
translations: เชิงปรัชญา
ยอมรับสิ่งที่เกิดขึ้น

meaning: ระมัดระวัง
examples: The author is cautious about drawing conclusions from limited data.
A cautious tone suggests awareness of complexity.
She was cautious in her claims, acknowledging uncertainty.
translations: ระมัดระวัง

meaning: มั่นใจในตัวเอง / กล้าแสดงออก
examples: The author's assertive tone leaves no room for doubt.
Being assertive does not mean being aggressive.
She made her point in a confident, assertive manner.
translations: มั่นใจในตัวเอง
กล้าแสดงออก

meaning: เร่งด่วน
examples: The report uses urgent language to call for immediate action.
Her urgent tone reflects the seriousness of the situation.
The letter conveyed an urgent need for policy reform.

meaning: เยาะเย้ย / ล้อเลียน
examples: The author's mocking tone ridicules the opposition's arguments.
His mocking laughter was inappropriate given the situation.
She used a mocking style to dismiss the opponent's logic.

meaning: ป้องกันตัว / ตั้งรับ
examples: His defensive tone suggested he felt attacked by the criticism.
She became defensive when her findings were questioned.
A defensive argument often signals insecurity in one's position.
translations: ป้องกันตัว

meaning: พูดตรงไปตรงมา / ซื่อสัตย์
examples: She gave a candid assessment of the program's failures.
His candid admission surprised the audience.
A candid tone builds trust with the reader.
translations: พูดตรงไปตรงมา

meaning: วิจารณ์ / ตำหนิ
examples: The review was highly critical of the government's response.
Critical thinking is essential for evaluating arguments.
She wrote a critical analysis of the novel's themes.

meaning: คิดถึงด้วยความอาลัย / เศร้าอาลัย
examples: Her wistful tone conveys longing for a lost era.
He wrote with a wistful sadness about his childhood home.
The poem ends on a wistful note, full of gentle regret.
translations: คิดถึงด้วยความอาลัย
เศร้าอาลัย

meaning: กำกวม / ไม่ชัดเจน
examples: The author's conclusion is ambiguous and open to interpretation.
Ambiguous language can lead to misunderstanding.
The law is ambiguous on this particular issue.

meaning: กังวล / กลัว
examples: The narrator's apprehensive tone reflects fear of the unknown.
She was apprehensive about speaking in front of a large audience.
An apprehensive mood pervades the opening chapter.

meaning: ยอมรับชะตากรรม / ยอมจำนน
examples: His resigned tone suggests he has given up hope for change.
She spoke with a resigned acceptance of the outcome.
The community felt resigned to living with the problem.
translations: ยอมรับชะตากรรม

meaning: ท้าทาย / ดื้อรั้น
examples: Her defiant response challenged the authority of the committee.
The activist's defiant speech inspired the crowd.
A defiant tone signals refusal to yield under pressure.

meaning: ตลกขบขัน (ไม่เหมาะกับสถานการณ์)
examples: His facetious remarks during the debate frustrated many listeners.
A facetious tone is inappropriate in a serious academic essay.
She made a facetious comment that offended the grieving family.
translations: ตลกขบขัน (ไม่เหมาะกับสถานการณ์)

meaning: พูดเล่น / ไม่จริงจัง
examples: His flippant reply showed he did not take the issue seriously.
A flippant tone undermines the credibility of an argument.
She dismissed the complaint with a flippant wave of her hand.
translations: ไม่จริงจัง

meaning: ไม่เชื่อ / งงงวย
examples: She looked at him with an incredulous expression.
The author's incredulous tone reflects disbelief at the evidence.
He was incredulous that the plan had actually succeeded.

meaning: วางท่าดูถูก / ทำราวกับว่าอีกฝ่ายด้อยกว่า
examples: The article's patronizing tone assumes readers cannot think for themselves.
She found his explanation patronizing and overly simplified.
A patronizing attitude damages relationships and trust.
translations: วางท่าดูถูก
ทำราวกับว่าอีกฝ่ายด้อยกว่า

meaning: ภาษาพูดทั่วไป / ภาษาปาก
examples: Colloquial language makes the article feel casual and accessible.
Avoid colloquial expressions in formal academic writing.
The author uses colloquial phrases to appeal to everyday readers.
translations: ภาษาพูดทั่วไป

meaning: อย่างไรก็ตาม
examples: The plan seemed sound; however, it failed in practice.
He tried his best; however, the results were disappointing.
However, not everyone agreed with the final decision.
translations: อย่างไรก็ตาม

meaning: อย่างไรก็ตาม
examples: The task was difficult; nevertheless, they completed it on time.
He was exhausted; nevertheless, he continued working.
Nevertheless, the results offered some encouraging signs.
translations: อย่างไรก็ตาม

meaning: ดังนั้น / เป็นผลให้
examples: She studied every night; consequently, she passed with high marks.
The factory closed; consequently, hundreds lost their jobs.
Consequently, the project was delayed by several months.

meaning: ยิ่งกว่านั้น
examples: The policy reduces costs; furthermore, it improves morale.
Furthermore, the study found no significant side effects.
She is highly skilled; furthermore, she works exceptionally hard.
translations: ยิ่งกว่านั้น

meaning: ในทางกลับกัน
examples: He prefers action movies; conversely, she enjoys documentaries.
Conversely, the second study found the opposite trend.
More rules do not always improve safety; conversely, they can create confusion.
translations: ในทางกลับกัน

meaning: ดังนั้น
examples: The evidence is conclusive; therefore, the case is closed.
She trained daily; therefore, she was well prepared.
Therefore, we must take immediate action.

meaning: ยิ่งกว่านั้น
examples: The product is affordable; moreover, it is highly effective.
Moreover, the research revealed additional long-term benefits.
He is talented; moreover, he brings a positive attitude to the team.
translations: ยิ่งกว่านั้น

meaning: ในทางกลับกัน
examples: Urban life is exciting; on the other hand, it can be stressful.
On the other hand, the second candidate had far more experience.
The policy saves money; on the other hand, it reduces services.
translations: ในทางกลับกัน

meaning: ในทำนองเดียวกัน
examples: She smiled warmly; likewise, he responded with kindness.
Likewise, the second study reached the same conclusion.
Treat others with respect; likewise, you will receive respect.
translations: ในทำนองเดียวกัน

meaning: เช่นเดียวกัน
examples: Similarly, the second group showed significant improvement.
She remained composed under pressure; similarly, her team stayed calm.
Similarly, other nations face the same environmental challenge.
translations: เช่นเดียวกัน

meaning: อย่างไรก็ตาม
examples: The challenge was immense; nonetheless, they succeeded.
Nonetheless, the idea deserves serious consideration.
He disagreed with the ruling; nonetheless, he respected it.
translations: อย่างไรก็ตาม

meaning: เพราะฉะนั้น
examples: The data was unreliable; hence, the results were questioned.
The product was expensive; hence, few customers bought it.
Hence, we decided to revise our entire strategy.
translations: เพราะฉะนั้น

meaning: ดังนั้น / ด้วยวิธีนี้
examples: He saved money carefully and thus bought a house.
The results were clear; thus, the experiment was declared a success.
Thus, we can conclude that the hypothesis was supported.
translations: ด้วยวิธีนี้

meaning: ตามนั้น / ดังนั้น
examples: The rules changed; act accordingly.
She was given more responsibility and compensated accordingly.
Accordingly, the committee revised its original decision.

meaning: ต่อมา
examples: He was arrested and subsequently charged with fraud.
She graduated and subsequently found a well-paying job.
The law was passed and subsequently enforced nationwide.

meaning: ในขณะเดียวกัน
examples: She worked on the report; meanwhile, her colleague set up the presentation.
Meanwhile, the situation at the border continued to deteriorate.
He studied late into the night; meanwhile, the rest of the household slept.
translations: ในขณะเดียวกัน

meaning: เป็นผลให้
examples: The drought destroyed crops; as a result, food prices soared.
She trained intensively; as a result, her performance improved dramatically.
As a result of the new policy, unemployment fell significantly.

meaning: นอกจากนี้
examples: In addition, the study found a strong link between diet and mood.
She is a skilled researcher; in addition, she is an excellent writer.
In addition to reducing costs, the plan also improves efficiency.

meaning: ถึงแม้ว่า
examples: Despite the rain, the outdoor event continued as planned.
She succeeded despite many obstacles in her path.
Despite the evidence, he refused to change his position.

meaning: ทั้งๆ ที่
examples: In spite of the criticism, the author stood by her argument.
He continued working in spite of his illness.
In spite of limited resources, the team achieved impressive results.
translations: ทั้งๆ ที่

meaning: แม้ว่า
examples: Although the task was difficult, she completed it ahead of schedule.
Although he disagreed, he respected the group's decision.
Although evidence was limited, the findings were suggestive.

meaning: แม้กระนั้น
examples: The argument has weaknesses; even so, the core claim is valid.
Even so, no one could deny that progress had been made.
She faced enormous criticism; even so, she pressed forward.
translations: แม้กระนั้น

meaning: ตรงกันข้าม
examples: He is not lazy; on the contrary, he works harder than anyone.
On the contrary, the new policy made the situation worse.
She did not give up; on the contrary, she redoubled her efforts.
translations: ตรงกันข้าม

meaning: หรืออีกทางหนึ่ง
examples: You can take the train; alternatively, you can drive.
Alternatively, we could postpone the project until next quarter.
Consider solar power; alternatively, invest in wind energy.
translations: หรืออีกทางหนึ่ง

meaning: ในขณะที่ / แต่ว่า
examples: She prefers reading, whereas he enjoys outdoor activities.
Whereas the first study found clear benefits, the second was inconclusive.
Urban areas grew rapidly, whereas rural regions declined.

meaning: โดยเฉพาะ
examples: Specifically, the report focuses on air quality in urban areas.
She asked specifically for a full refund.
He specifically mentioned the need for longer deadlines.

meaning: ยกตัวอย่างเช่น
examples: Many factors contribute to success; for instance, hard work matters greatly.
For instance, the study found benefits in just eight weeks.
Consider the role of technology; for instance, social media changed communication.
translations: ยกตัวอย่างเช่น

meaning: ทั้งๆ ที่ / แม้กระนั้น
examples: Notwithstanding the difficulties, they completed the project on time.
The law applies notwithstanding any prior agreement.
Notwithstanding her fear, she gave a powerful speech.
translations: ทั้งๆ ที่
แม้กระนั้น

meaning: นอกจากนี้ / ยิ่งกว่านั้น
examples: Further research is needed to confirm these findings.
She provided further evidence to strengthen her argument.
Further, the data suggests a long-term trend, not a temporary one.
translations: ยิ่งกว่านั้น

meaning: ยอมรับว่า
examples: Granted, the solution is imperfect, but it is better than nothing.
Granted, he made mistakes, but he learned from each one.
Granted that the task is hard, we still need to attempt it.

meaning: เพราะว่า
examples: She succeeded because she worked consistently every day.
He was late because his car broke down unexpectedly.
We canceled the event because of dangerous weather conditions.

meaning: ดังนั้น
examples: The evidence was overwhelming, so the jury reached a verdict quickly.
She was tired, so she went to bed early.
The project was delayed, so the deadline was extended.

meaning: ด้วยเหตุนี้
examples: The data was incomplete; for this reason, the study was retracted.
For this reason, early education is considered essential.
He lacked the required qualifications; for this reason, he was not hired.
translations: ด้วยเหตุนี้

meaning: แต่ถึงกระนั้น
examples: The task was enormous, yet the team completed it on time.
She had little experience, yet she outperformed the veterans.
Yet, some experts remain unconvinced by the evidence.
translations: แต่ถึงกระนั้น

meaning: แต่ก็ยังคง
examples: The problem was identified years ago; still, little has changed.
She has faced many setbacks; still, she remains determined.
Still, the author's main argument deserves consideration.
translations: แต่ก็ยังคง

meaning: ด้วย / เช่นกัน
examples: The law reduces inequality; it also promotes economic growth.
She is a researcher and also an award-winning author.
Reading improves vocabulary; it also builds critical thinking.

meaning: นอกจากนี้
examples: Besides being highly qualified, she has years of experience.
Besides, it is too late to change the plan now.
He has many skills; besides, he is a natural leader.

meaning: ถ้าหาก
examples: If you study consistently, you will improve your score.
If the policy is not revised, inequality will worsen.
If the evidence is weak, the argument cannot stand.

meaning: ยกเว้นว่า
examples: The project will fail unless we address the funding gap.
Unless you provide evidence, your claim remains unsupported.
He will not change his mind unless presented with new data.

meaning: โดยมีเงื่อนไขว่า
examples: You may take time off, provided that your work is complete.
The plan is acceptable, provided that all parties agree.
Provided that conditions improve, we will continue the program.
translations: โดยมีเงื่อนไขว่า

meaning: ประการแรก
examples: First, gather all the evidence before drawing conclusions.
First, the author establishes the historical context.
First, consider the long-term impact of the policy.

meaning: จากนั้น
examples: First, analyze the data; then, draw your conclusions.
She reviewed the draft, then submitted it to the editor.
Then, the committee voted on the final proposal.

meaning: หลังจากนั้น
examples: He graduated; afterward, he found a job within two weeks.
The law was passed; afterward, enforcement began immediately.
She finished the report and went home afterward.
translations: หลังจากนั้น

meaning: กฎหมาย / การออกกฎหมาย
examples: New legislation was passed to protect workers' rights.
The legislation aims to reduce carbon emissions by 2030.
Activists lobbied for stronger environmental legislation.
translations: การออกกฎหมาย

meaning: ตัดสิทธิ์การเลือกตั้ง
examples: New voter ID laws could disenfranchise minority communities.
Historically, many groups were disenfranchised by unjust laws.
The policy was accused of disenfranchising low-income voters.
translations: ตัดสิทธิ์การเลือกตั้ง

meaning: ให้สิทธิ์เลือกตั้ง
examples: The amendment enfranchised women for the first time.
Efforts to enfranchise marginalized communities continued for decades.
Reformers sought to enfranchise all adult citizens.
translations: ให้สิทธิ์เลือกตั้ง

meaning: การแก้ไขเพิ่มเติม (กฎหมาย)
examples: The First Amendment protects freedom of speech.
Congress proposed an amendment to strengthen voting rights.
The amendment was ratified by the required number of states.
translations: การแก้ไขเพิ่มเติม (กฎหมาย)

meaning: สิทธิ์ออกเสียงเลือกตั้ง
examples: Women fought for suffrage for more than seventy years.
Suffrage is a fundamental right in any true democracy.
The suffrage movement changed the course of American history.
translations: สิทธิ์ออกเสียงเลือกตั้ง

meaning: เขตเลือกตั้ง / กลุ่มผู้สนับสนุน
examples: The senator regularly met with her constituency to listen to concerns.
The party lost support among its core constituency.
Each constituency elects one representative to the legislature.
translations: เขตเลือกตั้ง
กลุ่มผู้สนับสนุน

meaning: สองพรรคร่วม / ข้ามพรรค
examples: The bill passed with bipartisan support in the Senate.
A bipartisan approach is needed to address the budget crisis.
Bipartisan cooperation is rare in today's divided political climate.
translations: สองพรรคร่วม

meaning: ให้สัตยาบัน / รับรอง
examples: The treaty must be ratified by two-thirds of the Senate.
Enough states ratified the amendment for it to become law.
The country was slow to ratify the international agreement.
translations: ให้สัตยาบัน

meaning: การสนับสนุน / การรณรงค์
examples: Her advocacy for education reform spanned three decades.
Advocacy groups lobbied for stronger environmental protections.
His advocacy work helped change the law on workers' rights.
translations: การสนับสนุน

meaning: เกี่ยวกับพลเมือง
examples: Voting is a fundamental civic duty in a democracy.
Civic engagement strengthens communities and democratic institutions.
The school promotes civic responsibility through service learning.
translations: เกี่ยวกับพลเมือง

meaning: พันธมิตร / กลุ่มรวม
examples: A broad coalition of groups supported the new legislation.
The coalition worked together despite differing priorities.
Building a strong coalition is key to political success.

meaning: เขตอำนาจศาล
examples: The case falls under federal, not state, jurisdiction.
Local courts have limited jurisdiction in national matters.
Different laws apply depending on the jurisdiction.
translations: เขตอำนาจศาล

meaning: นโยบาย
examples: The new policy aims to reduce income inequality.
Policy changes require careful analysis of likely impacts.
She advocated for evidence-based policy in public health.

meaning: ฝักใฝ่พรรค / ลำเอียงทางการเมือง
examples: The debate became increasingly partisan over the years.
Partisan politics often prioritizes party over national interest.
Critics called the decision partisan rather than principled.
translations: ฝักใฝ่พรรค
ลำเอียงทางการเมือง

meaning: ยับยั้ง / อำนาจยับยั้ง
examples: The president threatened to veto the spending bill.
Congress overrode the veto with a two-thirds majority.
The mayor used her veto power to block the development plan.
translations: อำนาจยับยั้ง

meaning: การลงประชามติ
examples: The government called a referendum on independence.
Citizens voted in a national referendum on the new constitution.
The referendum result surprised even the most experienced analysts.
translations: การลงประชามติ

meaning: ผู้มีสิทธิ์เลือกตั้ง / ส่วนประกอบ
examples: Every constituent has the right to contact their representative.
The senator listened carefully to constituent concerns.
Water is a key constituent of all living organisms.
translations: ผู้มีสิทธิ์เลือกตั้ง
ส่วนประกอบ

meaning: พระราชกฤษฎีกา / คำสั่ง
examples: The president issued a decree banning the practice.
The court decree required immediate changes to the policy.
By royal decree, the law was suspended pending review.
translations: พระราชกฤษฎีกา

meaning: ล็อบบี้ / กดดันทางการเมือง
examples: Corporations spend millions to lobby Congress each year.
Environmental groups lobby for stronger regulations.
She worked as a professional lobbyist in Washington D.C.
translations: กดดันทางการเมือง

meaning: ยกเลิก / ทำให้เป็นโมฆะ
examples: The court ruled to nullify the unconstitutional law.
New evidence could nullify the original verdict.
The contract was nullified because one party violated its terms.
translations: ทำให้เป็นโมฆะ

meaning: กฎหมาย / พระราชบัญญัติ
examples: The statute prohibits discrimination in public accommodations.
The lawyer cited a specific statute in her argument.
Congress passed a new statute to protect consumers from fraud.
translations: พระราชบัญญัติ

meaning: ข้อจำกัด
examples: Every study has limitations that researchers must acknowledge.
The policy has significant limitations that reduce its effectiveness.
Understanding the limitations of the data is essential.

meaning: การใช้สิทธิ์ / การพึ่งพา
examples: Citizens have legal recourse if their rights are violated.
Without recourse to the courts, they had no way to seek justice.
The only recourse available was to file a formal complaint.
translations: การใช้สิทธิ์

meaning: การลงโทษ / การตอบแทน
examples: The victims sought retribution through the legal system.
Retribution is one theory of criminal punishment.
He feared retribution for speaking out against the corruption.

meaning: แตกต่างกันมาก / ไม่เหมือนกัน
examples: The two groups had disparate views on immigration policy.
The study drew from disparate data sources across regions.
Disparate outcomes for different groups suggest systemic inequality.
translations: แตกต่างกันมาก
ไม่เหมือนกัน

meaning: การฟ้องร้อง / คดีความ
examples: The company faced costly litigation after the product recall.
Litigation can take years and drain significant resources.
She chose mediation over litigation to resolve the dispute.
translations: การฟ้องร้อง

meaning: โจทก์
examples: The plaintiff filed a lawsuit alleging workplace discrimination.
The court ruled in favor of the plaintiff.
As the plaintiff, she bore the burden of proving her case.

meaning: จำเลย
examples: The defendant pleaded not guilty to all charges.
The lawyer argued that the defendant had acted in self-defense.
Under the law, every defendant is presumed innocent.

meaning: อคติ / ความลำเอียง
examples: Racial prejudice continues to affect hiring decisions.
The judge ruled that the evidence had created prejudice against the defendant.
Prejudice stems from ignorance and fear of the unknown.
translations: ความลำเอียง

meaning: ความเป็นธรรม / ความเท่าเทียม
examples: The policy aims to promote equity in access to education.
Equity requires giving people what they need, not just equal treatment.
Racial equity in the workplace remains a significant challenge.
translations: ความเป็นธรรม
ความเท่าเทียม

meaning: เกี่ยวกับระบบ / แพร่หลายในระบบ
examples: Systemic racism affects opportunity at every level of society.
The problem is not individual but systemic in nature.
Addressing systemic inequality requires structural changes.
translations: เกี่ยวกับระบบ
แพร่หลายในระบบ

meaning: การสะสม / การเพิ่มพูน
examples: The accrual of debt over many years put the company at risk.
Accrual accounting records revenue when earned, not when received.
The accrual of environmental damage cannot be easily reversed.
translations: การเพิ่มพูน

meaning: การยุติ / ข้อตกลง
examples: The two companies reached a financial settlement out of court.
The settlement required the company to pay compensation.
A negotiated settlement avoided a lengthy and costly trial.

meaning: ข้อร้องเรียน / ความไม่พอใจ
examples: Workers filed a formal grievance against the management's decision.
The colonists listed their grievances in the Declaration of Independence.
A fair grievance process is essential for workplace trust.
translations: ข้อร้องเรียน
ความไม่พอใจ

meaning: การตอบโต้ / การแก้แค้น
examples: She feared retaliation for reporting the abuse to authorities.
The law protects employees from retaliation for whistleblowing.
The attack was widely seen as an act of retaliation.
translations: การแก้แค้น

meaning: แก้ไข / บำบัด
examples: Remedial classes helped struggling students catch up.
The government launched a remedial program to address past injustices.
Remedial action was taken after the environmental violation.

meaning: แอบแฝง / ร้ายกาจโดยไม่เห็นได้ชัด
examples: Bias can be insidious, operating below the level of conscious awareness.
The disease is insidious because it shows no early symptoms.
Insidious misinformation spreads gradually without obvious signs.
translations: ร้ายกาจโดยไม่เห็นได้ชัด

meaning: ค่าตอบแทน / การชดเชย
examples: Workers received compensation for injuries sustained on the job.
Fair compensation is essential for attracting skilled employees.
She sought compensation after the accident through legal channels.

meaning: การอนุญาโตตุลาการ
examples: The dispute was resolved through binding arbitration.
Many employment contracts include mandatory arbitration clauses.
Arbitration is generally faster and less costly than court litigation.
translations: การอนุญาโตตุลาการ

meaning: การเลือกปฏิบัติ
examples: Discrimination in hiring based on race is illegal.
She filed a formal complaint about gender discrimination at work.
The law protects workers from discrimination in all its forms.
translations: การเลือกปฏิบัติ

meaning: การอนุรักษ์
examples: Conservation efforts have helped restore the forest ecosystem.
She dedicated her career to wildlife conservation.
Water conservation is increasingly important in drought-prone regions.
translations: การอนุรักษ์

meaning: ตกอยู่ในอันตราย
examples: Several imperiled species are now protected under federal law.
Rapid habitat loss has imperiled dozens of native birds.
The imperiled river ecosystem requires immediate restoration efforts.
translations: ตกอยู่ในอันตราย

meaning: ระบบนิเวศ
examples: Every organism plays a role in its ecosystem.
Deforestation can destroy an entire ecosystem within decades.
Protecting the coastal ecosystem benefits both wildlife and humans.

meaning: ความหลากหลายทางชีวภาพ
examples: Tropical rainforests contain extraordinary biodiversity.
Human activity threatens global biodiversity at an unprecedented rate.
Biodiversity is essential for ecosystem resilience and stability.
translations: ความหลากหลายทางชีวภาพ

meaning: การลดลง / การหมดสิ้น
examples: Depletion of natural resources poses a serious long-term threat.
The depletion of the ozone layer led to international agreements.
Groundwater depletion is a growing crisis in many regions.
translations: การหมดสิ้น

meaning: ที่อยู่อาศัยตามธรรมชาติ
examples: Deforestation destroys the natural habitat of countless species.
The polar bear's habitat is rapidly shrinking due to climate change.
Protecting habitat is the most effective way to prevent extinction.
translations: ที่อยู่อาศัยตามธรรมชาติ

meaning: การบรรเทา / การลดความรุนแรง
examples: Planting trees is one strategy for climate change mitigation.
The company invested in mitigation measures after the oil spill.
Mitigation of flood risk requires long-term infrastructure planning.
translations: การลดความรุนแรง

meaning: ความยั่งยืน
examples: Sustainability requires balancing economic growth with environmental protection.
The organization adopted a sustainability plan to reduce its carbon footprint.
Long-term sustainability must be the goal of any development policy.
translations: ความยั่งยืน

meaning: การเสื่อมสภาพ / การทำให้แย่ลง
examples: Soil degradation reduces agricultural productivity significantly.
The degradation of the coral reef threatens marine biodiversity.
Environmental degradation is accelerating in industrialized regions.
translations: การเสื่อมสภาพ
การทำให้แย่ลง

meaning: การรักษา / การอนุรักษ์
examples: The preservation of historic buildings protects cultural heritage.
Preservation of wetlands prevents flooding and supports wildlife.
Food preservation techniques have been used for thousands of years.
translations: การอนุรักษ์

meaning: การสูญพันธุ์
examples: Many species face extinction due to habitat destruction.
The extinction of the dinosaurs occurred approximately 66 million years ago.
Preventing extinction requires global cooperation and commitment.
translations: การสูญพันธุ์

meaning: โรงเพาะฟัก
examples: The salmon hatchery releases millions of fish into the river each year.
A fish hatchery can help replenish depleted wild populations.
The hatchery program was a key part of the restoration plan.
translations: โรงเพาะฟัก

meaning: การเสริม / การเพิ่มเติม
examples: Supplementation of wild fish populations helps prevent extinction.
Vitamin supplementation is recommended for people with certain deficiencies.
The program focused on supplementation rather than replacement of native species.
translations: การเพิ่มเติม

meaning: เกี่ยวกับนิเวศวิทยา
examples: The oil spill caused significant ecological damage to the coastline.
Ecological balance is fragile and easily disrupted by human activity.
Researchers conducted an ecological survey of the protected zone.
translations: เกี่ยวกับนิเวศวิทยา

meaning: บ่งบอก / เป็นลางสัญญาณ
examples: The declining bird population does not bode well for the ecosystem.
Early results bode well for the success of the new program.
Rising temperatures bode poorly for polar ice preservation.
translations: เป็นลางสัญญาณ

meaning: การละเมิด / การฝ่าฝืน
examples: The company was fined for a serious breach of environmental regulations.
A breach of contract can result in significant legal consequences.
The data breach exposed the personal information of thousands of users.

meaning: อย่างเป็นผลเสีย
examples: Pollution adversely affects the health of nearby communities.
The drought adversely impacted agricultural output for three years.
The decision adversely affected workers in the manufacturing sector.
translations: อย่างเป็นผลเสีย

meaning: การแพร่กระจาย / การขยายตัว
examples: The proliferation of invasive species threatens native biodiversity.
Nuclear proliferation remains one of the world's greatest security threats.
The proliferation of misinformation online is a growing concern.
translations: การแพร่กระจาย
การขยายตัว

meaning: พื้นเมือง / ท้องถิ่น
examples: Indigenous communities often have deep knowledge of local ecosystems.
The government violated the rights of indigenous peoples.
Indigenous plants are better adapted to local environmental conditions.

meaning: เปราะบาง / ได้รับผลกระทบได้ง่าย
examples: Children and the elderly are most vulnerable during heat waves.
Vulnerable ecosystems require special legal protections.
The policy aims to protect the most vulnerable members of society.
translations: ได้รับผลกระทบได้ง่าย

meaning: การแสวงหาประโยชน์ / การใช้ประโยชน์
examples: The exploitation of natural resources must be regulated carefully.
Workers spoke out against the exploitation of underpaid labor.
Economic exploitation of developing nations remains a global concern.
translations: การแสวงหาประโยชน์
การใช้ประโยชน์

meaning: การฝึกงาน
examples: She completed a summer internship at a leading law firm.
Many companies offer internships to recruit future full-time employees.
Unpaid internships raise serious questions about labor fairness.

meaning: ค่าตอบแทน / ค่าจ้าง
examples: The position offers generous remuneration and benefits.
Fair remuneration is essential for attracting and retaining skilled workers.
The union negotiated higher remuneration for all employees.

meaning: ไม่มีการควบคุม
examples: Unregulated industries often cause greater harm to workers and consumers.
The unregulated market led to dangerous working conditions.
Critics argue that unregulated technology companies pose serious risks.
translations: ไม่มีการควบคุม

meaning: ผู้สนับสนุน / ผู้เสนอ
examples: She is a leading proponent of criminal justice reform.
Proponents of the policy argue it will reduce inequality.
He became a vocal proponent of renewable energy solutions.
translations: ผู้สนับสนุน

meaning: แพร่หลาย / พบได้บ่อย
examples: Income inequality is increasingly prevalent in developed nations.
Misinformation is prevalent on social media platforms.
A prevalent view among researchers is that prevention is more effective than cure.

meaning: เกี่ยวกับบริษัท / องค์กร
examples: Corporate social responsibility has become a major business priority.
The scandal exposed widespread corporate corruption.
She climbed the corporate ladder through talent and dedication.
translations: เกี่ยวกับบริษัท

meaning: ทำกำไรได้มาก / มีรายได้ดี
examples: Real estate investment can be extremely lucrative in growing cities.
She found a lucrative career in the technology sector.
The deal turned out to be far more lucrative than expected.
translations: ทำกำไรได้มาก
มีรายได้ดี

meaning: ยกเว้น / ได้รับการยกเว้น
examples: Small businesses may be exempt from certain labor regulations.
Nonprofit organizations are often exempt from paying income tax.
The regulation exempts companies with fewer than ten employees.
translations: ได้รับการยกเว้น

meaning: การบังคับ / การข่มขู่
examples: The confession was obtained through coercion and is therefore invalid.
Coercion in the workplace violates employees' fundamental rights.
The agreement was signed under coercion and later challenged in court.

meaning: ยากลำบาก / ต้องใช้ความพยายามมาก
examples: The data collection process was laborious and time-consuming.
Reforming a complex legal system is a laborious undertaking.
She completed the laborious task without complaint.
translations: ต้องใช้ความพยายามมาก

meaning: เจรจาต่อรอง
examples: Workers have the legal right to negotiate their wages collectively.
The two parties negotiated for weeks before reaching an agreement.
She successfully negotiated a better contract for her team.
translations: เจรจาต่อรอง

meaning: มีสิทธิ์ / ได้รับสิทธิ์
examples: Every worker is entitled to a safe working environment.
Citizens are entitled to equal protection under the law.
She felt entitled to the promotion after years of dedicated service.
translations: ได้รับสิทธิ์

meaning: อำนาจ / คำสั่งที่มีผลผูกมัด
examples: The new law mandates paid family leave for all workers.
The agency received a clear mandate to regulate emissions.
A mandate from voters gave the party authority to implement change.
translations: คำสั่งที่มีผลผูกมัด

meaning: ดุลยพินิจ / การตัดสินใจ
examples: Judges use discretion when determining appropriate sentences.
Managers must exercise discretion when handling confidential information.
The decision was left to the discretion of the committee.
translations: การตัดสินใจ

meaning: นิติศาสตร์ / หลักกฎหมาย
examples: Constitutional jurisprudence evolves through court decisions over time.
Her expertise in labor jurisprudence made her a leading authority.
This case will have a lasting impact on environmental jurisprudence.
translations: นิติศาสตร์
หลักกฎหมาย

meaning: การปฏิบัติตามกฎ
examples: The company achieved full compliance with safety regulations.
Compliance with environmental standards is legally required.
Regular audits ensure ongoing compliance across all departments.
translations: การปฏิบัติตามกฎ

meaning: การกำหนดมาตรฐาน
examples: Standardization of testing procedures improves reliability.
The industry called for standardization of safety protocols.
Standardization allows different systems to work together effectively.
translations: การกำหนดมาตรฐาน

meaning: การละเมิด
examples: The company was fined for a serious safety violation.
Voting rights violations were documented in several states.
A violation of the agreement would result in immediate penalties.

meaning: การชดเชย / ค่าตอบแทน
examples: She sought recompense for the damage caused by the company's negligence.
The court ordered full recompense for all affected workers.
A formal apology was offered as recompense for the error.

meaning: การทำงานอัตโนมัติ
examples: Automation has replaced many routine manufacturing jobs.
The automation of customer service reduced costs significantly.
Workers are concerned about the impact of automation on employment.
translations: การทำงานอัตโนมัติ

meaning: การล้าสมัย
examples: Rapid technological change accelerates product obsolescence.
Planned obsolescence encourages consumers to buy new products regularly.
The obsolescence of certain skills requires workers to retrain constantly.
translations: การล้าสมัย

meaning: ผลผลิต / ประสิทธิภาพการผลิต
examples: New software increased the team's productivity by thirty percent.
Employee well-being is closely linked to workplace productivity.
Automation can boost productivity while reducing labor costs.
translations: ประสิทธิภาพการผลิต

meaning: การนำไปปฏิบัติ
examples: Successful policy depends on careful implementation.
The implementation of the new system took longer than expected.
Challenges in implementation often undermine well-designed policies.
translations: การนำไปปฏิบัติ

meaning: ความแม่นยำ
examples: The surgeon operated with extraordinary precision.
Precision is essential in scientific measurement and reporting.
She delivered her argument with clarity and precision.
translations: ความแม่นยำ

meaning: การบูรณาการ / การรวมกัน
examples: The integration of new technology improved workflow significantly.
Social integration promotes cohesion in diverse communities.
The successful integration of the two departments improved communication.
translations: การบูรณาการ

meaning: ประสิทธิภาพ
examples: Streamlining the process improved overall efficiency.
Fuel efficiency is a key factor for consumers choosing a car.
Greater efficiency in government reduces waste and saves taxpayer money.
translations: ประสิทธิภาพ

meaning: ปฏิกิริยาต่อต้าน
examples: The new policy faced a significant backlash from workers.
Social media amplified the public backlash against the decision.
The company suffered a backlash after the controversial advertisement.
translations: ปฏิกิริยาต่อต้าน

meaning: การรบกวน / การเปลี่ยนแปลงอย่างรุนแรง
examples: Technological disruption is transforming entire industries.
The strike caused major disruption to public transportation.
Innovation often creates disruption before it delivers lasting benefit.
translations: การเปลี่ยนแปลงอย่างรุนแรง

meaning: ความซ้ำซ้อน / การถูกเลิกจ้าง
examples: Automation has led to significant redundancy in the manufacturing sector.
The company offered generous packages to workers facing redundancy.
Redundancy in a system can actually improve resilience and reliability.
translations: ความซ้ำซ้อน
การถูกเลิกจ้าง

meaning: ความเป็นไปได้
examples: A feasibility study was conducted before approving the project.
The feasibility of the proposal depends on available funding.
Experts questioned the feasibility of meeting the aggressive deadline.
translations: ความเป็นไปได้

meaning: เพิ่มเติม / ขยาย
examples: Technology can augment human capabilities rather than replace them.
The program aims to augment workers' skills for the digital economy.
She sought to augment her income through freelance work.

meaning: ลูกผสม / รูปแบบผสม
examples: Many companies now offer hybrid work models combining remote and office days.
Hybrid vehicles use both electric and gasoline power.
The hybrid approach combines the best elements of two methods.

meaning: ไม่เคยมีมาก่อน
examples: The pandemic caused unprecedented disruption to the global economy.
Unemployment reached unprecedented levels during the financial crisis.
The technology represents an unprecedented leap forward in computing.
translations: ไม่เคยมีมาก่อน

meaning: การแทนที่ / การพลัดถิ่น
examples: Automation has caused widespread job displacement in manufacturing.
The war led to the displacement of millions of civilians.
Economic displacement requires government support for retraining programs.
translations: การพลัดถิ่น

meaning: ล้าสมัย
examples: Fax machines have become largely obsolete in the digital age.
Skills that were once valuable can quickly become obsolete.
The outdated software was declared obsolete and replaced.

meaning: ต้องใช้เงินทุนสูง
examples: Nuclear energy is a capital-intensive technology with high upfront costs.
Manufacturing semiconductors is one of the most capital-intensive industries.
Capital-intensive projects require long-term financial planning and commitment.
translations: ต้องใช้เงินทุนสูง

meaning: การพักชำระหนี้ / การระงับชั่วคราว
examples: The government declared a moratorium on new oil drilling permits.
A moratorium on debt repayments was granted to struggling nations.
Environmental groups called for a moratorium on deep-sea mining.
translations: การพักชำระหนี้
การระงับชั่วคราว

meaning: ความสามารถในการแข่งขัน
examples: Investing in education improves a nation's long-term competitiveness.
The company's global competitiveness depends on innovation.
Wage growth must be balanced with maintaining economic competitiveness.
translations: ความสามารถในการแข่งขัน

meaning: ฝึกทักษะใหม่ / อบรมใหม่
examples: Workers displaced by automation need opportunities to retrain.
The government funded programs to retrain unemployed factory workers.
She chose to retrain as a data analyst after her industry declined.
translations: ฝึกทักษะใหม่

meaning: เพิ่มความรุนแรง / เร่งขึ้น
examples: The report asserts that climate change is accelerating.
Technology is accelerating at an unprecedented rate.
The accelerating pace of change challenges traditional systems.
translations: เพิ่มความรุนแรง

meaning: น่าตกใจ / น่าเป็นห่วง
examples: The rate of deforestation is alarming.
Scientists have found alarming levels of pollution in the ocean.
The alarming statistics prompted immediate government action.
translations: น่าเป็นห่วง

meaning: ทดแทนไม่ได้
examples: These ancient forests are irreplaceable.
She was an irreplaceable member of the team.
Once lost, this biodiversity is irreplaceable.
translations: ทดแทนไม่ได้

meaning: รุนแรง
examples: The drought had severe consequences for local farmers.
Severe weather conditions disrupted travel across the region.
The patient suffered severe side effects from the treatment.

meaning: ภัยคุกคาม
examples: Pollution and overfishing are major threats to marine life.
The report identified three key threats to national security.
Climate change poses serious threats to global food supplies.

meaning: ความพยายาม
examples: Despite efforts to reduce emissions, pollution levels remain high.
Conservation efforts have helped increase the tiger population.
Her efforts to improve education inspired the whole community.
translations: ความพยายาม

meaning: อนุรักษ์ไว้
examples: Preserving natural habitats is essential for biodiversity.
The museum is dedicated to preserving cultural heritage.
Local communities play a key role in preserving traditions.
translations: อนุรักษ์ไว้

meaning: ถือว่า / ได้รับการพิจารณา
examples: Coral reefs are considered among the most diverse ecosystems.
She is considered one of the greatest scientists of her time.
This region is considered a biodiversity hotspot.
translations: ได้รับการพิจารณา

meaning: แนวโน้ม
examples: Current trends suggest that temperatures will continue to rise.
Researchers identified troubling trends in public health data.
Economic trends indicate a slowdown in growth.

meaning: สิ่งที่เหลืออยู่
examples: Much of the rainforest remains untouched by human activity.
The question of funding remains unresolved.
Only a fraction of the original population remains.
translations: สิ่งที่เหลืออยู่

meaning: ความหลากหลาย
examples: The Amazon rainforest is known for its incredible diversity.
Diversity in the workplace leads to more creative solutions.
Species diversity is a key indicator of ecosystem health.
translations: ความหลากหลาย

meaning: ยอดเยี่ยม / ไม่ธรรมดา
examples: Coral reefs support an extraordinary variety of marine life.
She showed extraordinary courage under pressure.
The discovery was an extraordinary breakthrough in medicine.

meaning: เกี่ยวกับทะเล
examples: Marine biologists study life in the ocean.
Plastic pollution threatens marine ecosystems worldwide.
The government established a marine protected area.
translations: เกี่ยวกับทะเล

meaning: การฟอกขาว
examples: Rising ocean temperatures cause coral bleaching.
Bleaching events have increased in frequency over the past decade.
Severe bleaching can kill entire reef systems.

meaning: ขับออก / ไล่ออก
examples: Stressed coral expels the algae living in its tissues.
The student was expelled for violating school rules.
The body expels toxins through sweat and urine.

meaning: สาหร่าย
examples: Coral reefs depend on algae for nutrition and color.
Algae blooms can deplete oxygen in the water.
Some species of algae are used as a food source.

meaning: เนื้อเยื่อ
examples: The algae live within the coral's tissues.
Damaged tissues require time and nutrients to heal.
Scientists studied the tissues under a microscope.
translations: เนื้อเยื่อ

meaning: ทำให้หายใจไม่ออก
examples: Agricultural runoff causes algae blooms that suffocate marine life.
The thick smoke suffocated the firefighters.
Plants can suffocate if their roots are completely submerged.
translations: ทำให้หายใจไม่ออก

meaning: ทนทานต่อ
examples: Some coral species are more resistant to bleaching than others.
The bacteria became resistant to antibiotics.
Researchers are developing heat-resistant crop varieties.

meaning: ซ้ำๆ
examples: Repeated bleaching events prevent coral from recovering.
She made repeated attempts to contact the organization.
Repeated exposure to stress can harm mental health.

meaning: ทอดยาว / ขยาย
examples: The Great Barrier Reef stretches over 2,300 kilometers.
The desert is stretching further each year due to climate change.
A long highway stretching across the plains came into view.

meaning: หอย
examples: The octopus is a type of mollusk.
Mollusks such as clams and oysters filter water naturally.
Scientists discovered a new species of deep-sea mollusk.

meaning: สามารถ
examples: Some coral species are able to recover if conditions improve.
She was able to complete the project ahead of schedule.
Not all students are able to access quality education.
